instruction_summary: Bring the Pierce-Schott (2016) WTO/PNTR NTR-gap identification into the ADH commuting-zone frame and estimate the long-run (through 2023/24) impact of China's WTO entry on US local labor markets, as a 25-year event study plus a bridge to and anchor against the realized-import (dIPW) results of follow-ups 001/002.

steps.description: Symlinked staged data into workspace and verified NEW_FETCH md5s (frs_tariff, cbp_annual, ps2020)

Built NTR-gap shock: 1999 HS8 spread -> HS6 (simple + import-weighted) -> sic87dd -> CZ NTRgap (722 CZs). Validated vs PS sic4 recipe (r=0.959), moments (mean 0.326/sd 0.164), correlations vs dIPW (0.50 pop-wtd) and Persistence (0.79).
Built C1 annual panel: CBP mfg jobs / working-age pop, 1998-2023 (26 CBP years parsed + cached); plus jobs-denominator series.
Fetched annual LAUS 1990-2024 (3,105 counties) from FRED - 001's checkpoint only had 5 snapshot years, but the load-bearing C2 pre-trend needs annual 1990s.
Built C2 CZ panels: unemp/pop, NILF proxy (2000-2024) and unemployment rate (1990-2024, the continuous pre-trend series).
Built C3 (QCEW log weekly wage) and C4 (BEA log real transfers pc) snapshot level panels.
Estimated Arm A event study (year-by-year WLS, 2 specs x 2 gap aggregations x per unit/iqr/sd), A4 bridge 2SLS, Arm B anchor 2SLS, and the Sec-4 variant.
Produced flagship event-study figure and Arm A vs Arm B comparison figure.

key_results.pre_trend_verdict: FLAT - C2 LAUS unemployment rate 1991-1999 all within 1 SE of 0; first loads at 2001 (accession year)
key_results.arm_agreement: Arm A (per IQR) 2019 -1.46*/2023 -1.49*; Arm B (per $1k dIPW) 2019 -0.497*/2023 -0.432* - same sign, both permanent (no 2019->2023 recovery)
key_results.sec4_variant: NTR gap loads beyond realized dIPW (2012 per-IQR -1.08); dIPW also loads (-0.104*) -> A4 exclusion restriction rejected, A4 reported as descriptive bridge not causal
key_results.scaling_freeze: IQR 0.0668, sd 0.0533 (headline simple-mean NTRgap, unweighted, 722 CZs)

comparison_to_original.quantity: Permanent manufacturing level effect at 2023 (Arm B anchor)
comparison_to_original.note: 5-decimal reproduction; confirms the 'hit is permanent' claim is identification-robust across the two shocks

comparison_to_original.quantity: ADH realized-import mfg employment effect (per $1k, ADH era)
comparison_to_original.note: Arm A measures the tariff-uncertainty (PNTR) shock, deliberately NOT ADH's measured-import estimand; per-IQR NTR-gap units are not comparable to per-$1k dIPW

comparison_to_original.quantity: Longest horizon of a published NTR-gap event study
comparison_to_original.note: the living element: 4-8 years past any published PNTR event study
validation gate 2 passed; PS sic4-recipe correlation r=0.959 (gate 1)

deviations: Re-fetched annual LAUS 1990-2024 from FRED (manifest-verified pattern): 001's staged laus_checkpoint.csv contained only the 5 snapshot years, not the annual 1990-2024 the manifest described, and the C2 1990-1999 pre-trend is the load-bearing falsification. Only fetch performed.

C2 pre-2000 falsification uses the LAUS unemployment rate (unemp/LF) because popest 15-64 starts in 2000; headline C2 (unemp/pop, NILF proxy) use popest and start 2000 (headline years 2007/12/19/24 unaffected).

C1 pre-2000 (1998/1999) anchors use a jobs denominator (mfg/total CBP emp) and are contaminated by the shock's mfg-share construction; shown flagged as supporting-only, not used as a falsification test.

A4 (dIPW instrumented by NTRgap) is reported as a descriptive bridge, not a causal 2SLS, and is not headlined, because the Sec-4 variant rejects its exclusion restriction (NTR gap loads on outcomes conditional on realized dIPW).
C4 terminal year 2022 (BEA CAINC35 vintage ends 2022); C3 event points at snapshot years only (2000/07/12/19/23); no extra QCEW years fetched.
NTRgap employment weights use the 1988 CBP vintage as the 1990 pre-period proxy (per spec option).
Outcomes are CBP/LAUS/QCEW/BEA proxies (no IPUMS person-level), inherited from 001.
